faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Sainik School Kapurthala Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the offline application form is 10 October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Lab Assistant and Group Employee posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies announced for the Lab Assistant and Group Employee positions in Sainik School Kapurthala Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for all the posts is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 50 years. Age relaxation will be applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for Lab Assistant posts?
faq.answer: For Lab Assistant (Chemistry) and Lab Assistant (Physics) posts, candidates must have passed Intermediate in Science with Chemistry or Physics as a subject, respectively, or an equivalent qualification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Lab Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The Lab Assistant posts offer a consolidated salary of Rs 40,800/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is Rs 500/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for SC/ST category candidates is Rs 250/-.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Sainik School Kapurthala Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Test, Skill Test, and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Is the application process online or offline?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Sainik School Kapurthala, which is www.sskapurthala.com.
